lines: - Tip-minted Nodes (supplement_2026-10e): N-11222, N-11223, N-11224, N-11225
- Episode: Amnesia Or Perjury? Exclusive Footage Of The OTHER Man On The Rooftop. | Ep 370
- Episode Number: CKA 136 · Monument Ep 136 · Batch 116
- Source Used: Transcript (with explicit video-display references) and YouTube ID AH1KVKkweUE
- Transcript Completeness Status: Full transcript provided; chapter-marked; music cues dropped
- Analyst / Agent: Investigative Analysis Agent (Episode Analysis Protocol)
- Existing Nodes Reused: N-1 (Charlie Kirk), N-2 (Erika Kirk)
- New Nodes Introduced (investigation targets): N-10699, N-10700, N-10701

Episode 136 advances two principal evidentiary threads. First, host Candace Owens introduces Mikey McCoy's arrival footage showing the SUV glove pocket as empty at the moment Charlie Kirk exited the vehicle, framing this against later testimony describing gloves being recovered from the same door pocket and against Brian Harpole's account of medical intervention in the car. Second, Owens presents what she characterizes as exclusive bystander footage timestamped 12:47 PM, allegedly identifying the "plainclothes man" Officer Bagley claimed not to recognize during preliminary-hearing testimony; she credits X user Muppet Masher with identifying the red-hat figure as Allan Robertson (USU Police, formerly USMC and San Bernardino PD) and the blue-shirt figure as Christopher Hawk, and surfaces a Brady List entry for Robertson.

Secondary threads include an Iran-war segment anchored to a CNN report on US Central Command crowdsourcing ideas against Iran, paired with archival Charlie Kirk clips calling such a war "pathologically insane" and characterizing it as "Israel's war," plus an Erika Kirk clip declining to state Charlie's position. The episode also contains an extended personal update on Candace's security guard who suffered a stroke in Russia, and a comments section. The episode functions structurally as a continuation of the "other man on the rooftop" / screwdriver-DNA sub-thread, adding a positively identified companion to the investigation ledger.

blocks.header: **C-11696** FBI agents arrived at UVU at 12:39 PM, 16 minutes after the 12:23 PM shooting

lines.v: Per a Kash Patel public statement played in the episode, the first FBI agents arrived at UVU with chiefs of police at 12:39 PM, 16 minutes after the 12:23 PM shooting, and secured the scene.
Verify the 12:39 PM arrival timestamp against UVU campus entry logs, FBI case file timestamps, and Patel/Dan Bongino interview transcripts.

blocks.header: **C-11694** Officer Bagley's body cam ran 27 min 35 sec and ended on the Losi rooftop
blocks.label: Officer Bagley's body cam ran 27 min 35 sec and ended on the Losi rooftop

lines.v: In a preliminary-hearing clip the host plays, a questioner describes Officer Bagley's body cam as 27 minutes 35 seconds, starting at the Hall of Flags and ending while he was still on the roof before crime tape was up, and Bagley agrees it is his only body cam footage that day.
Obtain the body cam file metadata and manufacturer battery-life specifications to verify whether 27 minutes is plausible as a battery depletion event.

blocks.header: **C-11692** Officer Bagley could not identify the plainclothes man who went with him to the Losi rooftop
blocks.label: Officer Bagley could not identify the plainclothes man who went with him to the Losi rooftop

lines.v: In a preliminary-hearing clip the host plays, Officer Bagley testifies that he did not know exactly who the plainclothes individual wearing a badge and carrying a handgun who accompanied him up the Losi building stairs was, nor what agency he was from or where he was from.
Cross-reference Bagley's testimony against UVU campus credentialing logs and the bystander footage in A-2227.1.

Compare Bagley's badge-and-handgun description with the bystander footage to verify whether the same individual matches both Bagley's testimony and the visual identification.
